title: Useless if a problem
text:
Useless if a problem. Product was fine for 3 years. Then I started to have a problem, which I wanted to discuss.

Their CS is useless. The person I contacted, had the attitude of “go away and leave me alone.”

Then he cut me off, when he was going to connect me to “pest control.”

product_metadata.title: SafeRest Premium 9" Thick Box Spring Encasement - Waterproof - Breathable, Noiseless and Vinyl Free - Fits Up to 9" - FullXL
features: Surrounds the box spring on all 6 sides with a durable high-grade polyester surface material
360 Secure zipper feature prevents accidental openings by sealing the end zipper traveler with a Velcro flap
description: SafeRest Box Spring Encasements Protect Your Box Spring Against Fluids
Through extensive research and development, SafeRest has created a better way to protect your box spring
Full Protection For Your Box Spring
Rather than disposing of expensive unprotected mattress sets, SafeRest encasements seal and safeguard your box spring.
SafeRest box spring encasements, with a soft polyester surface material and waterproof membrane back coating, were specifically designed and lab tested to protect your mattress

SafeRest's patented 360° Secure feature offers the ultimate in protection eliminating the risk that the end zipper traveler will pull back exposing the box spring. This is realized by securing the end traveler with a fold-over Velcro flap covering it on all sides.
Machine-wash with your sheets, tumble dry on low heat. Do not iron.
contain no vinyl, phthalates, flame retardants or PVCs.
To demonstrate SafeRest's commitment to quality, each product is backed by a full replacement
